nodes.description: Owner state variable in Owned, set to msg.sender in constructor and used by onlyOwner modifier.
Token symbol string state variable, set to HNL in Honolulu constructor.
Token name string state variable set in constructor.
Token decimals state variable used to scale the total supply.
Total token supply state variable, assigned with multiplication in the constructor.
Mapping of account balances, written by constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping written by approve and transferFrom.
External caller identity used for owner assignment, balance keys and allowance keys.
Internal pure addition helper using require(c >= a) overflow check.
Internal pure subtraction helper using require(b <= a) underflow check.
Internal pure multiplication helper using require(a == 0 || c / a == b) overflow check.
Internal pure division helper using require(b > 0) division-by-zero check.
Owned constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == owner; declared but unused by Honolulu.
Constructor setting token metadata, computing total supply and crediting the owner balance.
Public constant returning _totalSupply.
Public constant returning balances[tokenOwner].
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using SafeMath sub/add on balances.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens without allowance double-spend protection.
Transfers tokens from an approved owner, decrementing both balances and allowance.
Public constant returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts; contract rejects raw ETH.
SafeMath subtraction of tokens from balances[msg.sender] inside transfer.
SafeMath addition of tokens to balances[to] inside transfer.
SafeMath subtraction of tokens from balances[from] inside transferFrom.
SafeMath subtraction of tokens from allowed[from][msg.sender] inside transferFrom.
SafeMath addition of tokens to balances[to] inside transferFrom.
Multiplication 500000000 * 10**decimals computing the initial total supply in the constructor.

Raw uint256 multiplication c = a * b guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Raw uint256 division c = a / b guarded by require(b > 0).

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to the owner state variable inside the Owned constructor.
Owned constructor writes the privileged owner state variable from the untrusted caller.
onlyOwner modifier gates execution on require(msg.sender == owner).
onlyOwner reads the owner state variable for its authorization check.
Honolulu constructor indirectly relies on msg.sender as the deployer/owner that receives the full supply.
Constructor credits balances[owner] with the entire total supply.
decimals state variable is read to compute the initial supply.
Constructor assigns _totalSupply using an unchecked size computation expression.
Constructor sets the symbol state variable.
Constructor sets the name state variable.
Constructor sets the decimals state variable.
Constructor initializes balances[owner] with the total supply.
Constructor executes the multiplication/exponentiation that derives the total supply.
totalSupply returns the _totalSupply state variable.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the queried account.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping for from and to.
approve writes the allowed mapping for msg.sender and spender.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowed mapping of from and msg.sender.
allowance reads the allowed mapping for owner and spender.
transfer uses msg.sender as the key into the balances mapping.
approve uses msg.sender as the owner key of the allowed mapping.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender key of the allowed mapping.
transfer executes the subtraction of tokens from the caller balance.
Subtraction of sender balance is followed by addition to recipient balance in transfer.
Subtraction result is stored back into balances for the sender.
Addition result is stored into balances for the recipient.
transferFrom executes the subtraction on the source balance.
transferFrom then subtracts the same amount from the spender allowance.
transferFrom finally adds the amount to the recipient balance.
Source balance subtraction result is stored back into balances.
Recipient addition result is stored into balances.
Allowance subtraction result is stored back into the allowed mapping.
SafeMath.add performs the raw addition guarded by an overflow check.
SafeMath.sub performs the raw subtraction guarded by an underflow check.
SafeMath.mul performs the raw multiplication guarded by an overflow check.
SafeMath.div performs the raw division guarded by a non-zero check.

User supplied token amount is added to the recipient balance.

User supplied token amount is added to the recipient balance.
